description:
Workflows tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_workflows: List Draftless workflows — named, runnable pipelines you can inspect and then execute with `execute_workflow`.
- execute_workflow: Execute a published Draftless workflow by slug.
- list_recent_runs: List the signed-in user's most recent Draftless workflow executions with status, duration and credits used.
- quote_workflow: The exact credits one run of a workflow costs, line by line, from the same pricing the charge uses.
- create_schedule: Run a workflow on a timer or by signed webhook.
- list_schedules: List your schedules and your workspaces' schedules: type, timing, whether it is active or paused (and why), the next run, and the per-run an
- list_schedule_runs: The run history of one schedule: status (completed, failed, skipped_over_cap), what each run was quoted and charged, and the error for a fai
- pause_schedule: Pause a schedule so it stops running, or pass resume:true to start it again.
- delete_schedule: Permanently delete a schedule and its run history.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: workflows
title: Workflows
